title: The neoliberal legacy: successes, crises and debates
goal: Read a balanced account of the reforms, attributing each opinion, using creo que and no creo que.
grammar: opinion verbs with indicative and subjunctive

items: I can say what the defenders of the reforms believe.
I can say what the critics do not believe.
I can describe Mexico's crisis of December 1994 and the end of convertibility in Argentina.
I can give an opinion with *creo que* and *no creo que*, and say whose opinion it is.
